# Test applySubst for TypeName wildcard
ex {
	type T int
	T(0) -> T(1)
}
-- x.go --
package m

type MyInt int

var _ = MyInt(0)
var _ = int(0)
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@

 type MyInt int

-var _ = MyInt(0)
-var _ = int(0)
+var _ = MyInt(1)
+var _ = int(1)
